sections.title: Modern Software Supply Chains & Reachability Context

subtitles.title: Modern Software Supply Chains & Reachability Context
subtitles.text: Hello everyone, and respected judges! Today, modern applications are built using hundreds of open-source packages across npm, Python, Go, and GitHub workflows.

subtitles.title: Modern Software Supply Chains & Reachability Context
subtitles.text: While open-source libraries help us build products faster, managing their security has become extremely complex.

subtitles.title: Modern Software Supply Chains & Reachability Context
subtitles.text: In large codebases, applications often contain multiple levels of nested dependencies.

subtitles.title: Modern Software Supply Chains & Reachability Context
subtitles.text: The real challenge for engineering teams is knowing: Which vulnerabilities are actually reachable in production code, and which ones are never called?

subtitles.title: Modern Software Supply Chains & Reachability Context
subtitles.text: Without this reachability context, developers can spend weeks investigating alerts or risk breaking live backend APIs during package upgrades.

subtitles.title: Modern Software Supply Chains & Reachability Context
subtitles.text: This is why modern software security requires a deeper, code-aware approach.

subtitles.title: Introducing SupplyGraph: Unified ASPM Platform
subtitles.text: To address this challenge, we created SupplyGraph.

subtitles.title: Introducing SupplyGraph: Unified ASPM Platform
subtitles.text: SupplyGraph is an Application Security Posture Management platform designed to give developers complete visibility into their software supply chain.

subtitles.title: Introducing SupplyGraph: Unified ASPM Platform
subtitles.text: Instead of treating dependencies as flat isolated lists, SupplyGraph analyzes project call paths and builds an interactive visual attack graph.

subtitles.title: Introducing SupplyGraph: Unified ASPM Platform
subtitles.text: It connects your code from user-facing entry points all the way down to deeply nested libraries.

subtitles.title: Introducing SupplyGraph: Unified ASPM Platform
subtitles.text: It clearly verifies whether an execution path actually reaches a vulnerable component.

subtitles.title: Introducing SupplyGraph: Unified ASPM Platform
subtitles.text: When an issue is identified, SupplyGraph provides safe, line-by-line code patches that preserve application functionality, while testing untrusted packages inside an isolated sandbox.

sections.title: Four Breakthrough Capabilities: DAG, Blast Radius, AI Briefing & SBOM

subtitles.title: Four Breakthrough Capabilities: DAG, Blast Radius, AI Briefing & SBOM
subtitles.text: Let us look at four core capabilities of SupplyGraph:

subtitles.title: Four Breakthrough Capabilities: DAG, Blast Radius, AI Briefing & SBOM
subtitles.text: First is the Attack Graph. Powered by graph traversal algorithms, it visually maps the relationship between code and libraries, showing exact reachability paths.

subtitles.title: Four Breakthrough Capabilities: DAG, Blast Radius, AI Briefing & SBOM
subtitles.text: Second is the Blast Radius Score. It calculates a clear risk metric from 0 to 100, helping teams understand potential operational impact.

subtitles.title: Four Breakthrough Capabilities: DAG, Blast Radius, AI Briefing & SBOM
subtitles.text: Third is the Autonomous Executive AI. It summarizes technical vulnerability data into actionable briefings and prioritized containment steps.

subtitles.title: Four Breakthrough Capabilities: DAG, Blast Radius, AI Briefing & SBOM
subtitles.text: And fourth is the CycloneDX SBOM. It generates standard Software Bill of Materials documents with deterministic SHA-256 cryptographic verification for compliance.

sections.title: Five Preloaded Exploit Scenarios (Scenarios A through E)

subtitles.title: Five Preloaded Exploit Scenarios (Scenarios A through E)
subtitles.text: To demonstrate these capabilities, SupplyGraph includes five preloaded real-world scenarios:

subtitles.title: Five Preloaded Exploit Scenarios (Scenarios A through E)
subtitles.text: Scenario A illustrates a transitive Log4j call path, mapping how an incoming request travels through service layers to a vulnerable logging library.

subtitles.title: Five Preloaded Exploit Scenarios (Scenarios A through E)
subtitles.text: Scenario B examines Prototype Pollution, showing how improper object merging can be safely identified and corrected.

subtitles.title: Five Preloaded Exploit Scenarios (Scenarios A through E)
subtitles.text: Scenario C analyzes insecure Python pickle deserialization, demonstrating AST-level detection before code execution.

subtitles.title: Five Preloaded Exploit Scenarios (Scenarios A through E)
subtitles.text: Scenario D audits GitHub Actions workflows, ensuring runners and third-party actions use immutable commit hashes.

subtitles.title: Five Preloaded Exploit Scenarios (Scenarios A through E)
subtitles.text: And Scenario E tests lifecycle scripts, demonstrating how package installation hooks are monitored and controlled.

sections.title: Real-World Audit of knadh/listmonk & Full Platform Feature Tour

subtitles.title: Real-World Audit of knadh/listmonk & Full Platform Feature Tour
subtitles.text: Now let us examine a real-world open-source repository: listmonk by Kailash Nadh.

subtitles.title: Real-World Audit of knadh/listmonk & Full Platform Feature Tour
subtitles.text: When scanning a multi-module repository like this, SupplyGraph indexes all 35 submodules and manifests, providing a unified inventory across frontend, backend, and workflows.

subtitles.title: Real-World Audit of knadh/listmonk & Full Platform Feature Tour
subtitles.text: It identifies 21 findings across direct and transitive dependencies, computing a contextual Blast Radius score of 60 out of 100.

subtitles.title: Real-World Audit of knadh/listmonk & Full Platform Feature Tour
subtitles.text: With the 'Fix with AI' feature, SupplyGraph generates evidence-based, non-breaking remediation prompts specifically structured for AI coding agents like Antigravity, Cursor, and Copilot.

subtitles.title: Real-World Audit of knadh/listmonk & Full Platform Feature Tour
subtitles.text: In the AI Code Reviewer, developers inspect surgical unified git diffs that correct specific vulnerable lines rather than forcing broad version jumps.

subtitles.title: Real-World Audit of knadh/listmonk & Full Platform Feature Tour
subtitles.text: And in our Detonation Sandbox, lifecycle scripts run within an isolated container where unauthorized network connections and file modifications are safely contained.
